> Heating & air conditioning based in Seguin, Texas. Juan Rodriguez owns HVAC Pros and does the work himself. Reviewers say he shows up fast, explains every repair and never pushes equipment you don't need.

## Services
- AC repair & maintenance: Juan tracks down the real problem, shows you what he found and fixes it, often the same or next day.
- Heating & furnace repair: Furnaces and heaters brought back fast, including during a hard freeze.
- System replacement: Complete new systems installed cleanly, with every question answered along the way.
- Ductless mini splits: Trane and LG mini splits for rooms, additions and shops that central air doesn't reach.
- Ductwork & ventilation: New duct runs, returns and ventilation so the air actually reaches every room.
- Commercial & rooftop units: Rooftop package units and condensers for storage facilities and business properties.

## About
HVAC Pros Heating & A/C is owned and run by Juan Rodriguez in Seguin. Juan is the one who diagnoses the problem and does the install, and he replies to his Google reviews himself. The work runs from a drain line that stopped draining to complete duct and system replacements, for homeowners, rental owners, storage facilities and commercial buildings. Customers mention the arrival texts, follow-up check-ins, the photos of finished work and a job site left clean.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Will HVAC Pros try to sell me a new system?
  A: Reviewers say no. Juan diagnoses the actual problem and doesn't push equipment or fixes you don't need.
- Q: Can Juan come out on a Saturday or during a freeze?
  A: Hours are Monday to Saturday, 8 AM to 5 PM. Reviewers describe Juan coming out on a Saturday afternoon and during a hard freeze, so call even when it's urgent.
- Q: Do you install ductless mini splits?
  A: Yes. HVAC Pros installs Trane and LG mini splits and walks you through operation and maintenance.
- Q: Do you service rental and commercial properties?
  A: Yes. Juan handles rentals, storage facilities and business properties, including rooftop units.
- Q: Can I get an estimate online?
  A: Yes. HVAC Pros offers online estimates. Use the quote form or call (830) 743-7713.
